checks.title: eCTD v4.0 is a library only
checks.note: server/routes/ectd-v4.ts is mounted at /api/ectd (register-document-routes.ts:139-140), but PublishingCenter.tsx:7-14 calls it read/validate only; nothing assembles or transmits v4.
checks.fixOneLine: Out of scope for the FDA v3.2.2 pilot. Keep the Publishing Center labelled read-only. Wire the RPS packager into the submission build only if the founder makes v4 a launch requirement.

checks.title: Periodic review is incomplete
checks.note: client/src/concept2cure/quality/data.ts:103 still has const TODAY='2026-06-04'. SopRegister.tsx:378 flags rows with isReviewOverdue(d.nextReviewDate) against that date, not the server's overdue value. No review-complete action exists in server/routes/mdx-qms.ts.
checks.fixOneLine: In SopRegister.tsx:378, use the server's d.overdue, which hooks.ts adaptDoc must keep. Remove TODAY from data.ts (or default it to the current date). Add a signed 'review complete, no change' action that sets next_review_date from an interval. Start with a test that fails on a date between June and October.

checks.title: Approval is a single step with one signature
checks.note: document-approval-signature.ts:120 sets APPROVABLE_STATES={'in_review'} and refuses drafts at :238-242, so drafts can no longer be approved. Approval is still one signer with no reviewer/approver routing.
checks.fixOneLine: Add configurable approver routing with an N-signature quorum in server/services/qms/document-approval-signature.ts before the move to effective. Add a test showing that one signature does not make a document effective when two are required.

checks.title: No controlled copies or distribution
checks.note: A grep for 'controlled copy|uncontrolled|watermark' across server/services/qms, server/routes/mdx-qms.ts and client/src/concept2cure/quality returns no hits.
checks.fixOneLine: Render effective QMS documents to PDF with a CONTROLLED COPY watermark and an audit-logged print/download event in a server/services/qms render service. Add a gate test that fails when the PDF has no watermark.

checks.title: Change-control links are weak
checks.note: changeControl.service.ts:330 inserts a linked_ref/linked_id with no FK in migrations (a grep finds no constraint). Removal is still a hard DELETE FROM qms_change_links at :343.
checks.fixOneLine: Replace the hard DELETE with an unlink soft delete (removed_at/removed_by plus an audit row). Validate linked_id against the CAPA/deviation tables in the same org at insert. To add a column, amend the creating migration in place, per Rule 1.

checks.title: QMS writes only through the assistant
checks.note: SopRegister.tsx and ChangeControl.tsx still route create, revise and transition actions through onAsk(...) prompts (17 call sites, for example SopRegister.tsx:216,227,450 and ChangeControl.tsx:162,173,433). There are no governed forms.
checks.fixOneLine: Add governed forms (create SOP, open revision, change transition) that call the mdx-qms REST endpoints directly, with reason-for-change capture, and keep onAsk as an optional helper. Tester workaround: use the AnA prompts.

checks.title: Two official FDA form templates are unreviewed
checks.note: Two templates/forms/acroforms/*.manifest.json (the XFA 1571 and 3674 forms) still have reviewedBy:null and assetTrusted:false. The other three are now reviewed. The XFA field maps are code-reviewed in official-field-maps.ts.
checks.fixOneLine: A named reviewer checks the 1571 and 3674 XFA fills against the FDA forms and records reviewedBy/assetTrusted in their manifests.
